Dig Bern gold from life-science partners.

A Research & Expertise Navigator that turns scattered university web pages into source-backed experts, units and partners — powered by Apertus.

Built forTempTeam · October 2026

Why Bern

Switzerland's federal city, with a medtech engine behind it.

The canton's ambition

The Canton of Bern aims to be a leading international medical location by 2030, pooling the hospital, the university and industry.

The agency helps companies settle and grow in the canton: location advice, financing support, its partner network and events.

The gap BearMiner fills

The agency needs to know, fast, which companies fit Bern and which Bern experts to put them in touch with.

InselspitalSwitzerland's largest university hospital
University of BernRanked among the world's top 100
sitem-inselNational competence centre for translational medicine
ARTORG CenterBiomedical engineering, built with Inselspital
Diabetes Center BerneDiabetes technology, research and projects
IndustryYpsomed, CSL Behring and the Bern medtech network

Match score = six parts, max 100
Capability overlap25
Partnership readiness20
Medical focus15
Domain fit15
Swiss proximity15
Signal depth10
25+a match
50+gold match · P2
70+very strong · P1

Not life science? Score 0, never a made-up partial match.

BearMiner06

Purposeful AI · traceable by design

Apertus where language is hard. Rules where trust matters.

Apertus does

  • Bridges vocabulary — “glucose sensors” finds CGM, biosensing, metabolic monitoring
  • Reads companies — any-language pitch to a medical profile
  • Explains matches — a short, sourced reason per result

Code does

  • Decides the score — same input, same number, offline
  • Checks every claim against the source text
  • Collects and ranks research without a model or GPU
Quote or dropNo source quote (≥ 85% match), no item
Closed choiceOnly candidates it was given, with URLs
Honest gaps“No reliable match” instead of a guess
Verified locationBern points never from model memory

Technical rigour

The score separates real fits from noise.

Sample companyCoinsScore
Glucose-sensor start-up, Burgdorf (BE)87.0
Wearable CGM company, Zurich85.5
CGM maker, Chinese-language source72.0
Surgical navigation, Munich71.8

Our scorer on the repo samples: no LLM profile, no crawled Bern records loaded; Chinese text translated first. Backed by 30 labelled benchmark examples and tests for every evidence gate.

Current data inventory
  • 42source folders: UniBE departments and institutes, incl. ARTORG and Diabetes Center Berne
  • 15,299unique URLs in the crawl manifests (15,534 entries, 14,659 with HTTP 200)
  • 3,775HTML snapshots stored locally, about 162 MB
  • 5,675PDF links listed; no PDFs downloaded
BearMiner08

Sovereign · affordable · extensible

Runs on Bern's terms, air-gapped if needed.

Sovereign

Apertus v1.5 on an on-premise or Swiss-cloud endpoint also handles translation. Sovereign deployments switch off the Google Translate fallback (EXTERNAL_MT=0).

Low cost

Crawling and scoring need no GPU. LLM answers are cached, so re-runs are instant and identical.

Extensible

A new institution is one config entry — then re-run crawl and enrich. No pipeline rewrite.

# src/sources.json — add a source
{ "id": "newinst", "name": "New Institute", "url": "https://…", "institution": "…" }
